title: 2016 AMC 8 Problem 16
statement: Annie and Bonnie are running laps around a \(400\)-meter oval track. They started together, but Annie has pulled ahead, because she runs \(25\%\) faster than Bonnie. How many laps will Annie have run when she first passes Bonnie?

solutions.text:
Since Annie is \(25\%\) faster than Bonnie, for every lap Bonnie finishes, Annie completes \(1 \dfrac{1}{4}\) laps. Therefore, Annie gains a quarter lap every time Bonnie finishes a lap.

With this in mind, for Annie to completely lap Bonnie, Bonnie must finish \(4\) laps, which means that Annie finished \(5\) laps.

Thus, D is the correct answer.
hints: A \(25\%\) faster pace means Annie runs \(\frac{5}{4}\) as far as Bonnie in the same time.
Annie first passes Bonnie when she has gained one full lap.
